mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing overcast skies at 63 degrees near the Verona Public Library, accompanied by a Waning Gibbous moon.

The city is gearing up for election season, reminding residents that early voting for the November 3 election runs from October 20 through October 30 at City Hall. Also, road work on Highway M will require detours from October 6 through October 9.
There is plenty to do around town, including the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market today at Hometown Junction Park, trivia at the Bogey Factory today, and a happy hour at Art House 360 tomorrow.

Regarding the recent police report, officers responded to a situation on September 19 where a child was reported missing from Lincoln Street, though fortunately, they were found safely and reunited with their parents.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Double Strawberry, and you can head over to the store when it opens today at 10 AM.
